description_for_human: Pay-per-use information infrastructure - research, news, market data, weather, geocoding, and knowledge lookups, paid per request in USDC on Algorand via x402. No accounts, no API keys.
description_for_model: Callrack exposes paid HTTP capabilities (academic/news search, crypto/fx rates, weather, geocoding, holidays, Wikidata knowledge search, US Census data, and composite research/verify/evidence/compare endpoints) under api.callrack.xyz. Every call requires x402 payment: an unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header naming the exact price, network, and payTo address; pay that exact amount in USDC on the named Algorand network, then retry the same request with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header. Always trust the live 402 response's price over any cached or example value. Full machine-readable capability list: https://api.callrack.xyz/llms.txt. OpenAPI schema: https://api.callrack.xyz/openapi.json.
